# Local LLM Kit

> A lightweight Python interface for offline language models and local LLM servers. Import: `local_llm_kit`; distribution: `local-llm-kit`; license: MIT.

## Where it fits

Applications that want one OpenAI-shaped chat/completion interface across local runtimes, native tool calls and structured outputs where supported, an offline deterministic test backend, or small embedding/RAG helpers. The core client uses stdlib HTTP and typing-extensions; inference packages are optional extras.

## Actual API

`from local_llm_kit import LLM, chat, complete, embed, tool`

`LLM(model_path="echo", backend="echo").chat([{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}])` returns a dictionary; text is at `response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]`.

Backends: echo, transformers, llamacpp, ollama, openai-compat and experimental airllm. Server presets: sglang, vllm, lmstudio, localai, llama-server, jan, gpt4all, mlx-lm, koboldcpp and transformers-serve. These cover 12 distinct local runtimes (transformers-serve shares the transformers engine); this is not a usage ranking. A preset connects to an already-running server with a served model ID; it does not install or host that engine. GPT4All and MLX-LM presets have no embedding endpoint; use a separate embedding backend.

## Boundaries

The dev server additionally exposes a Responses-API subset (`POST /v1/responses`:
string/message-list input, instructions, function_call output items; stateful
options rejected) and aggregates upstream `/v1/models` listings. HTTP backends
retry transient failures on non-streaming calls (retries=2 default, 0 to fail
fast). RAG offers MMR diversification and dense+lexical hybrid search.
Capabilities depend on the chosen model/runtime. Protocol tests are not hardware
benchmarks. AirLLM call contracts are tested with doubles; real model/GPU
execution is not certified, and its stream is buffered. The bundled HTTP server
is a development shim. Remote tool execution defaults to off; per-call Python
tools are request-scoped. Weights and dependencies must be prepared before
offline use. These integrations are included in version 0.2.0.
